fixtures.preview: United's first competitive meeting with Cesc Fàbregas's Como on matchday 3 (3:45am Thursday in Sydney), four days after a 1-1 draw at Leeds.
talking_points: United are winless in five Premier League games and sit 13th; Mbeumo scored at Leeds but Calvert-Lewin equalised from a poorly defended set piece.
They lost at Atlético Madrid on 13 October in this competition, so the league phase is already getting tight.
Benjamin Sesko is out injured with no return date given, and Patrick Dorgu is expected to be out for weeks; Shaw and Mainoo are unconfirmed.
Como are reportedly in strong form, and former United academy defender Willy Kambwala plays for them.

fixtures.preview: A Sunday 2pm home game against Bournemouth, moved from Saturday for UK TV; United will be looking for their first league win in six.
A lunchtime trip to Stamford Bridge with a 12:30pm UK start.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford.
A Sunday 4:30pm UK home game against Aston Villa, picked for TV.
Sydney's first game since the 0-0 opening-night derby, at home on Sunday afternoon against the team that beat them 2-1 here in February.
talking_points: Sydney drew 0-0 with the Wanderers in the season opener; both coaches called it a scrappy, tactical game rather than a pretty one.
Adelaide won 2-1 at Allianz Stadium when the sides last met on 14 February.
Patrick Kisnorbo called the derby a base to build on; the club reported no men's injury news this week.
The club has just signed a 25-year deal to secure Allianz Stadium as its home ground.

fixtures.preview: A 5pm Halloween game at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's official home opener.
A Friday-night home game against the Mariners.
An away trip to Brisbane Roar at Kayo Stadium, 6:40pm Brisbane time (7:40pm Sydney).

notes: Searches this run returned thin results and many sites blocked automated access, so several sections are shorter than their limits rather than padded.

Man Utd: Leeds 1-1 United (Mbeumo 35', Calvert-Lewin 51') and the winless run of five (13th) are from Sports Mole and NBC/Yahoo reports. Como line-ups are not confirmed, Shaw's and Mainoo's availability is unknown, and the Como form line comes from a prediction site. The Bournemouth, Chelsea, Roma and Villa previews are short because no recent reporting on them was found.

Sydney FC: only four fixtures are listed because the round 6 match wasn't found, and the Melbourne City and Mariners times come from earlier club listings and a ticket-listing site. Adelaide team news wasn't found. Paramount+ streams every A-League match.

Big matches: Champions League games are on Stan Sport and El Clásico is on beIN Sports, which holds LaLiga rights in Australia but whose listing for this match wasn't opened. The Wallabies' November Tests were left out because no Australian broadcaster was confirmed.

Live sport: the Kings' 3pm start is from a third-party listing, and most ticket prices aren't published. No Matildas, Socceroos or Waratahs games in Sydney were found. The Sydney Challenger tennis (16–22 Nov) was left out because no venue or tickets page was found.

Local: no local news from the past 7 days was found, and South Eveleigh's own site listed no events (an 'Alice in Wonderland' family program was mentioned in one roundup but couldn't be confirmed). No Term 4 events were found on the schools' public sites.

Not found: Pokémon, Minecraft or Roblox events in Sydney, a junior parkrun near home, Sydney matcha pop-ups with current dates, football-boot or running-shoe sales (Rebel's mid-season sale ended 11 Oct), and children's author events at Kinokuniya or Dymocks.

Groceries: supermarket sites blocked access and the new Woolworths and Coles half-price lists (from Wed 21 Oct) weren't visible, so only a few priced items are listed. Three end today, and the catalogue pages show no was-prices.

Deals: items carried over from last run that couldn't be re-checked were dropped (Epic freebie, Sydney FC memberships, Aldi Special Buys toys). The Cyberpunk and Garmin entries link to the OzBargain front page rather than their own deal pages.
